description: This source file defines a public enumeration NetworkInterfaceIPv4 that provides functionality to retrieve IPv4 network interface addresses on the host machine. It includes a nested struct AddressEntry to represent individual interface entries and a static method addresses() to enumerate active network interfaces, filter for IPv4 addresses, and return their names and IP addresses.

methods.name: addresses
methods.description: Retrieves a list of network interface addresses by querying system interfaces, filtering for active IPv4 interfaces, and returning their names and IP addresses.
